source_study.original_file_name: Scaling of movement in Galapagos tortoises (data from Bastille-Rousseau et al. 2016).csv

scientific_question: The source publisher original file MD5 matches and registered native tortoise taxa exist in the Movebank catalog, but all 3 exact canonical taxon name matches in frozen q parser returned zero rows. Is the source taxon field missing, blank, different spelling, or a row-level nonnative label? Diagnose without reading movement outcome or changing original source sample.
raw_event_access_safety: Read ONLY the original CSV HEADER and per-row source taxon label column (if identified). No original tagged animal identifier, timestamps, precise coordinates, GPS speed, per-individual effects, calendar date or movement data may be read into an output object or written.
outputs: Original header names including only columns from a fixed allowlist taxonomy-relevant, and booleans for required GPS schema field presence; do not print entire header if potential sensitive custom columns.
Each unique source taxon string, number of rows, share of all source rows and whether it EXACTLY matches one of three registered study taxa, only when <=75 distinct labels.
Counts of null/empty native taxon labels, distinct raw source labels, rows scanned, and reason for mismatch.
No guessed synonym mapping, genus replacement, rescue, native taxon list changes or effect reruns until separately frozen taxonomy crosswalk with authoritative proof.
prior_science: Keep historic Galapagos SOURCE_NO_VALID_GPS_FIXES as recorded first parser state; interpret as STRICT TAXON_SCHEMA_HOLD pending mapping, not absence of original wildlife or proof of no GPS animals.
no_privacy: No individual tags or animal original timestamps/positions/year/date; source native taxon species names are public.
nonclaims: This is data-quality diagnosis only, not biological q/night-day, photoperiod, island syndrome or causal solar findings. Preserve old ERA5 12 source holds, external 48-source radiation direction negative replication and all old published q source results.
